tools.name: get_pricing
tools.description: Fetch current LMX Cloud per-call pricing catalog.

api_key.description: Optional LMX API key (lmx_...). Prefer MCP client Authorization header or env; use this to override per call.

tools.name: quote_price
tools.description: Estimate USDC cost for a single model call. Uses GET /v1/pricing with model and token params.

max_tokens.description: Optional max completion tokens for the quote.

api_key.description: Optional LMX API key (lmx_...). Prefer MCP client Authorization header or env; use this to override per call.

tools.name: list_models
tools.description: List currently supported LMX model aliases and providers.

api_key.description: Optional LMX API key (lmx_...). Prefer MCP client Authorization header or env; use this to override per call.

tools.name: get_status
tools.description: Fetch LMX Cloud provider health, fallback chain, and anchoring status.

api_key.description: Optional LMX API key (lmx_...). Prefer MCP client Authorization header or env; use this to override per call.

tools.name: get_balance
tools.description: Fetch USD credit balance for the caller API key. Requires authentication.

api_key.description: Optional LMX API key (lmx_...). Prefer MCP client Authorization header or env; use this to override per call.

tools.name: get_usage
tools.description: Fetch request and token usage totals for the caller API key. Requires authentication.

api_key.description: Optional LMX API key (lmx_...). Prefer MCP client Authorization header or env; use this to override per call.

tools.name: web_search
tools.description: Real-time web search via LMX (Brave Search passthrough). Fixed per-call USDC price from the caller's API key balance. Returns title/url/snippet results.

api_key.description: Optional LMX API key (lmx_...). Prefer MCP client Authorization header or env; use this to override per call.

tools.name: extract_pdf
tools.description: Extract text and light structure (title, headings, page count) from a PDF via LMX pdf-extract. Provide file_url and/or file_base64. Requires a real LMX API key (same gate as web_search).

file_url.description: Optional https URL to fetch the PDF from. Provide this and/or file_base64.

file_base64.description: Optional base64-encoded PDF bytes (raw base64 or data:application/pdf;base64,...). Provide this and/or file_url.

api_key.description: Optional LMX API key (lmx_...). Prefer MCP client Authorization header or env; use this to override per call.

tools.name: chat_completion
tools.description: Call LMX Cloud OpenAI-compatible chat completions. Prefers a pre-funded API key (Bearer / api_key); when omitted and x402 is enabled, requires a USDC pay-per-call payment. Optional image_url / images enable vision input (OpenAI content-parts format) — use a vision model such as llama-3.2-90b-vision, qwen-3.6-35b, or qwen-3.5-35b.

prompt.description: User prompt to send to the selected model.

image_url.description: Optional image as an https URL or data:image/...;base64,... URI. Requires a vision-capable model.

images.description: Optional additional images (https URLs or data:image/...;base64,... URIs). Requires a vision-capable model.

model.description: Optional model name or alias. Uses default if omitted.

api_key.description: Optional LMX API key (lmx_...). Prefer MCP client Authorization header or env; use this to override per call.
